description: Track policy and reputation blocks separately from hard and soft bounces
checkSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS present FROM pragma_table_info('subscribers') WHERE name = 'block_bounce_count'

description: Configure campaign reply addresses per newsletter
checkSql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('newsletters') WHERE name = 'reply_to_address') = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('newsletters') WHERE name = 'reply_to_author') = 1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('campaigns') WHERE name = 'reply_to_address') = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS present

description: Configure optional personalized email headers per newsletter
checkSql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('newsletters') WHERE name IN ('mail_merge_enabled', 'mail_merge_html', 'mail_merge_text')) = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS present

description: Choose incoming email placeholders or a separately prepended mail merge header
checkSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS present FROM pragma_table_info('newsletters') WHERE name = 'mail_merge_incoming'

description: Track durable updates, deployment locks and encrypted per-update credentials
checkSql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name IN ('update_jobs','update_lock','update_events','update_cache')) = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS present

description: Record single-use console update requests completed through Cloudflare OAuth
checkSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS present FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='update_intents'

description: Store subscriber first and last names, derive the full name, and record tracking consent
checkSql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_xinfo('subscribers') WHERE name IN ('first_name', 'last_name', 'full_name', 'tracking_consent', 'tracking_consent_at')) = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS present

description: Enable open and click tracking per newsletter
checkSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS present FROM pragma_table_info('newsletters') WHERE name = 'tracking_enabled'

description: Choose between an added footer and a footer written in the incoming email
checkSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS present FROM pragma_table_info('newsletters') WHERE name = 'footer_incoming'

description: Keep the send backlog in the database and dispatch it within the daily sending budget
checkSql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('sends') WHERE name IN ('batch_id','claimed_at','attempts','next_attempt_at')) = 4 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='dispatch_state') = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS present
